title: Place order
intro: Dry and chilled are separate orders for the same delivery date. Chilled goods travel only on reefer trucks.

cutoff.after: After the cutoff, your order moves to the next run ({{next}}).
cutoff.closedBody: An order placed now is delivered on {{delivery}}.

items.title: 2 · Items
items.separate: Chilled items go on the Chilled order tab and are saved as their own order.

summary.title: Order summary
summary.hint: Confirmation IDs appear instantly. The ETA window arrives when tonight's plan is published, after the cutoff.

review.title: Review orders
review.subtitle: Delivery {{day}} · {{outlet}}
review.hint: Each order gets its own confirmation ID right away. The ETA window arrives when tonight's plan is published.

catalogue.title: Products
catalogue.intro: Add items to your {{day}} order. Only {{brand}} items for your outlet are listed, with last week's quantity.

ordering.nonOperatingDay: There are no deliveries on that day. The order moves to the next operating day.

fresh.separateChilled: Fresh outlets order dry goods every trading day. Chilled goods go as their own order.

style.weeklyDay: Style outlets place one weekly order for their scheduled delivery day.
style.peakAhead: A festival is coming. Style outlets usually order more ahead of it.

tech.singleItems: Tech outlets order as needed, usually single large items.

errors.load: Can't load the catalogue. Check the connection and try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Nothing more was placed. Try again: an order already placed is not placed twice.
errors.rejected: The server did not accept the order. Check the items and try again.
errors.partial_one: {{count}} order was placed before this happened.
errors.partial_other: {{count}} orders were placed before this happened.
